raw.details:
InnoVenture 2026 – International Innovation & Technology Challenge is an international-level innovation hackathon organized by Amity University Uttar Pradesh. The competition aims to bring together talented undergraduate and postgraduate students from diverse disciplines to develop innovative, technology-driven solutions for real-world challenges.

The theme for this year’s competition is:

Measuring ROI & Impact of Emerging Technologies: Driving Innovation Through Creativity, Conclusive Thinking, Collaboration for a Sustainable Planet.

Participants will collaborate in teams to identify problems, propose innovative solutions, and present their ideas before an expert jury. The challenge encourages interdisciplinary collaboration, innovation, sustainability, and practical implementation.

Core Focus Areas

Participants may submit solutions in one or more of the following domains:

  • Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
  • Cybersecurity & Data Privacy
  • Sustainability & Smart Green Solutions
  • AR/VR & Next-Generation Technologies
  • Automation, Robotics & Productivity
  • Digital Transformation & Enterprise Solutions

Eligibility

  • Open to Undergraduate and Postgraduate students from recognized colleges and universities worldwide.
  • Students from all academic disciplines are eligible to participate.
  • Both technical and non-technical students are encouraged to apply.
  • Cross-disciplinary teams are encouraged.

Team Formation

  • Team Size: 2–4 members
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialization/inter-department teams are allowed.
  • Each participant can be a member of only one team.
  • Every team must nominate one Team Leader for communication purposes.

Competition Format

Round 1 – Online Proposal Submission

Teams are required to submit a proposal based on the selected problem statement or innovative idea.

Each submission should include:

  • Problem Statement
  • Concept Note
  • Proposed Solution
  • Innovation Highlights
  • Rough Sketch or Wireframe (if applicable)
  • Implementation Roadmap
  • Expected Impact
  • Business/ROI Considerations

Submission Format: PDF

Maximum File Size: 10 MB

Submission Deadline: 25 September 2026

Round 2 – Hybrid Presentation

The Top 10 shortlisted teams will present their solution before the jury through a hybrid presentation.

Presentation Duration:

  • 10 minutes Presentation
  • 5 minutes Question & Answer Session

Evaluation will focus on innovation, feasibility, sustainability, implementation strategy, and business value.

Date: 12 October 2026

Final Round – Grand Finale

The Top 5 teams will qualify for the Grand Finale at Amity University Uttar Pradesh.

Each finalist team will demonstrate their prototype or proof of concept before the Grand Jury.

Presentation Duration:

  • 12 minutes Presentation & Prototype Demonstration
  • 8 minutes Jury Interaction

Date: 13 October 2026

Evaluation Criteria

Criteria

Weightage

Innovation & Creativity

25%

Technical Feasibility

20%

Sustainability & Social Impact

20%

ROI & Business Value Proposition

15%

Scalability & Implementation Roadmap

10%

Presentation & Team Collaboration

10%

Important Dates

Activity

Date

Registration Opens

31 July 2026

Last Date for Registration

11 September 2026

Proposal Submission Deadline

25 September 2026

Shortlisted Teams Announcement

5 October 2026

Hybrid Presentations

12 October 2026

Grand Finale

13 October 2026

Award Ceremony

13 October 2026

Rules & Guidelines

  • Teams must consist of 2–4 members.
  • Participants can register in only one team.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • Teams may choose any focus area relevant to the event theme.
  • All submissions must be original and created by the participating team.
  • Plagiarism, copied content, or use of unauthorized material will result in immediate disqualification.
  • AI tools may be used responsibly for research and development, but the submitted work must represent the team’s own understanding and innovation.
  • Organizers reserve the right to verify any submission.
  • Late submissions will not be accepted.
  • Teams shortlisted for the final round must be available to present on the scheduled dates.
  • Participants are expected to maintain professional and ethical conduct throughout the competition.
  • The decision of the organizing committee and jury shall be final and binding.

Why Participate?

  • Showcase your ideas on an international platform.
  • Solve meaningful real-world challenges.
  • Present before academic and industry experts.
  • Gain recognition from Amity University.
  • Build your portfolio with an impactful project.
  • Network with innovators, mentors, and peers.
  • Receive certificates and compete for prestigious awards.
